clusters.summary: The vessel is said to have overturned after being hit by strong waves.

clusters.headline: Cancer survivor forced to resign from school after tussles over work-from-home arrangements wins S$20,000
clusters.summary: The woman had originally been allowed to work from home two days a week to help her recovery but was suddenly told she had to work at the campus five days a week and that her medical documentation was inadequate.

clusters.headline: ‘Harder to sing’: Music industry veterans Dick Lee and Jeremy Monteiro weigh in on NDP 2026 songs debate
clusters.summary: Some commenters say this year's NDP tracks don't feel like traditional National Day anthems. Local music industry icons Dick Lee and Jeremy Monteiro weigh in on the debate and the role of younger voices in shaping Singapore's musical identity.

clusters.headline: Ethiopian death row inmates desperate to escape execution in Saudi Arabia call the BBC
clusters.summary: Dozens, many from Tigray, are awaiting execution - some called the BBC to tell their stories.

clusters.headline: 1 year in, National Guard became a part of D.C. life. And, deadly quake hits Colombia
clusters.summary: Today marks one year since the National Guard was deployed to the nation's capital. Here's what has happened since. And, a 7.4 magnitude earthquake leaves more than 100 people dead in Colombia.

clusters.headline: Kenya: MPs Put Kenya Law Reform Commission On Spot Over Sh2.1mn Unauthorised Spending
clusters.summary: [Capital FM] Nairobi -- Members of Parliament have put the Kenya Law Reform Commission (KLRC) on the spot over millions of shillings in expenditure that was not approved by the commission, with the Auditor-General warning that the institution failed to follow budget reallocation procedures.

clusters.headline: A burial row over Zambia's late president has turned its election into a hot contest
clusters.summary: Hakainde Hichilema was a shoo-in for a second term but the controversy following Edgar Lungu's death has dented his chances.

clusters.headline: Africa: A Century of Agricultural Investment in Sudan - Why Has Development Failed?
clusters.summary: [African Arguments] This article is translated and adapted from an Arabic article published in Sudanese Online. The ideas reflect arguments presented by the author in his book on agriculture in Sudan.

clusters.headline: Two swimmers to receive S$10,000 scholarship each under new Joseph Schooling award
clusters.summary: An initial S$200,000 fund has been established for the award.

clusters.headline: Nigeria: Nigeria and Mozambique Show How Health Systems Can Withstand Funding Cuts
clusters.summary: [allAfrica] For decades, many health programmes across sub-Saharan Africa have relied on a familiar model: donors fund disease-specific projects, parallel delivery structures are built around them, and services expand or contract with the funding cycle.

clusters.headline: Trump pivots back to sanctions for Iran as other strategies to end his war fizzle
clusters.summary: The shift comes as U.S. stockpiles of key weapons have dwindled and as stop-start talks seem again to have stalled. But Trump insists the pressure can lead to a breakthrough.
